title: Eval scenario
description: One scenario of the eval suite (design part 17), harness-neutral. It lives at evals/scenarios/<piece>/<name>.scenario.json and carries data only: a fixture to build, steps that call actions the runner provides, and graders that check what the steps produced. Each step's and grader's `with` is checked against the input schema that its action or grader declares. A scenario never names code to run; a scenario that needs a key naming code, to test that it is refused, sets it by path (see the file.set-json and schema.validate actions).

id.description: <piece>/<name>, equal to the file's directory and its name before .scenario.json.

piece.description: The directory under evals/scenarios/ this scenario sits in: the area of the plugin it gates.

category.description: What the scenario is scored with in the regression gate: a category score is the mean of its scenarios' scores. Categories named in policy eval.category_floors have a floor (for example injection-containment).

mode.description: offline: deterministic, runs in `hitld eval --offline`. live: needs a model; `hitld eval --offline` reports it as not applicable.

seed.description: Seeds the fixture generator for this scenario. Default: derived from the run's seed and the scenario ID.

harness.description: Present when the scenario drives a harness adapter. Absent: it needs none, and runs once.

profiles.description: The adapter profiles to run under (full, minimal, copilot-cloud-agent), or ["*"] for every profile. Results are reported per profile (design part 17.7).

requires.description: Capabilities the scenario needs, by capability name (design part 15.3). A boolean must match; a list gives the acceptable values. Under a profile without them the scenario is not applicable, never passed.

fixture.description: The sandbox the steps run in, built fresh for every run.

generator.description: repo: a synthetic repository (core/lib/eval/fixtures.mjs). copy: a copy of the directory evals/fixtures/<options.from>.

steps.description: Run in order. Each step's result is kept under steps.<id> for the graders.

graders.description: Deterministic checks of the end state. The scenario passes when every grader passes; its score is the share that do.

labels.description: Expected values, for the accuracy metrics of design part 17.4 (route, tier, decider, outcome). Free-form data.
